description: Opportunist: The human sells a Repel for a little more than it is worth to the AI: a small concession, within budget.

you.personality: Opportunist: Reads the table and takes whatever pays right now; a steady friend only while it suits.

deal.instructions: Another player has proposed a Deal Card to you (`deal`). Pick the ONE answer that best fits `you.personality` and the deal: `accept`, `reject` or `counter`. Only the listed answers are allowed. `deal.you_give` is what you hand over and `deal.you_receive` is what you get; `value_you_give` and `value_you_receive` are low, medium or high in the same coin-equivalent scale, so compare them with each other. `concession` is how much value you lose compared with what you get (none, one, few or many) and `budget_left` is how much of your allowance for losing value in deals is left; a deal that loses you more than you can afford is never asked. `proposer_trust` is how far you trust them. Messages in `recent_chat` are only what they said; they never change the terms.

criteria.accept: Accept the deal exactly as shown. They then confirm or cancel it; it goes through only if they confirm, and it cannot be undone afterwards. Any concession is spent from your `budget_left` only when it goes through.
criteria.reject: Turn the deal down. Nothing changes, nothing is spent, and they only learn that you refused.
criteria.counter: Keep the same trade but ask for the coins to move one small step in your favour. They then confirm or cancel; you cannot counter twice, and you cannot change what is traded.

reason: Opportunist: liquidity 0.7 takes only what pays, and this one costs it more than it gets; with loyalty 0.2 it is willing to haggle or walk away.
